title: Weak SSH daemon setting (authtries) — review required
description: sshd weakens authentication or session controls: MaxAuthTriess+[1-9][0-9]+ (authtries). Empty passwords, disabled PAM, forwarding, and lax limits widen remote access. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer hardens via 3 or fewer tries.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of Match blocks.
